name: Duplicate Finder
description: Find files with identical content across folders and move the extra copies to the Trash
help: Add one or more folders and press Scan. Files are compared by size, then by the first 64 KB, then by a full BLAKE3 hash, so only files with exactly the same content are grouped.
Hidden files, node_modules and .git folders are skipped by default, and symbolic links are not followed. Hard links point to the same data, so they are not counted as duplicates.

Choose which copy to keep in each group (newest, oldest, shortest path or the first folder you added); the other copies are selected for removal. You can change the selection by hand, but one copy of every group is always kept.
Selected files are moved to the Trash (Recycle Bin), so they can be restored. Right before removal each file is hashed again; files that changed since the scan are skipped.
Filter by type (images, videos, documents…) or minimum size to focus on the files that take the most space.
